units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 1:2">B. Mets. I, 2</cite> <he>היו רוֹכְבִין … אחד רוֹכֵב וכ׳</he> if two persons (each claiming to be the finder of an object) were riding …, or one was riding and one leading.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 1:1">Ḥag. I, 1</cite>; Y. ib. I, 76ᵃ top <he>כל שאינו יכול לִרְכּוֹב וכ׳</he> a child too young to be carried on his father’s shoulder.
<cite ref="Berakhot 56b:16">Ber. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>רְכָבוֹ</he> if he dreamt that he rode on him.
Gen. R. s. 75 רוֹכְבֵי סוסים riders on horses; a. fr.—Part. pass. רָכוּב; f. רְכוּבָה &c. riding.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 26">Ex. R. s. 26</cite> <he>תינוק שהיה ר׳ על וכ׳</he> a child that was riding on his father’s shoulder.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 1:3:1">Y. B. Mets. I, beg. 7ᵈ</cite> <he>אשה … ר׳ וכ׳</he> if a woman rides on a beast led by two men; a. fr.—[Pesik. Vayhi, p. 4ᵃ <he>רכובים</he>, read <he>דב׳</he>, v. <cite ref="D00039"><he>דָּבַב</he> II</cite>.]
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 91b:1">Snh. 91ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>ה׳ חיגר על וכ׳</he> he made the lame ride on the blind man.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 91b:1">Ib.</cite> <he>בא והַרְכִּיבֵנִי</he> come and carry me on thy back; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מוּרְכָּב</he>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 52b">Ib. 52ᵇ</cite> I remember when I was a child <he>ומ׳ על כתיפו וכ׳</he> and rode on my father’s shoulder &c.; (Tosef. ib. IX, 11 <cite ref="T00752"><he>רכוב</he></cite>); a. e.

Tosef. Sabb. XII (XIII), 14 המַרְכִּיב קנה וכ׳ if one inserts the branch of a candlestick; (Sabb. 47ᵃ המחזיר). Y. ib. XII, beg. 13ᶜ המרכיב מיטה וכ׳ he who sets up a folding couch; a. e.—Esp. to inoculate, engraft.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 2:6">Shebi. II, 6</cite> <he>אין … ואין מַרְכִּיבִין וכ׳</he> we must not plant, nor sink a vine, nor engraft before the Sabbatical year &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 4:8">Pes. IV, 8</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab. Y. B. Bath. IV, end, 14ᵈ <he>החרוב המ׳</he> a newly inoculated carob tree; a. e.
